title: Home and contents insurance

paragraphs.text: Good afternoon, Apex Insurance. Sarah speaking. How may I help you?
Hi, Sarah. I'm calling to get a quote for home and contents insurance. My current policy is about to expire, and so I'm calling different insurance companies to look for a better deal.
Okay, sure. First, can I have your name, please?
It's Joe Williams.
Okay, Joe. Now, can I get some details about your property, so I can work out a quote for you?
Sure.
What's the address?
It's 48 Silk Terrace, as in the material, and that's in Avalon
Mm-hmm. I'll just note that down. And is that a house?
Yeah, that's right.
Are you the sole owner of the property?
I'm the co-owner with my wife, and we currently live in the house.
Okay. And when was the property built?
Our suburb was developed in 2008, but our house didn't get built until 2010, and we moved in two years later, in 2012, if that's important.
Great. And can you give me some details about the construction of the house? First of all, the walls, are they made of, for example, wood or stone?
The outer walls are brick.
So it's got a very solid exterior.
It sure has.
And how about your roof?
The property had a metal roof when we moved in, but we wanted something sturdier, so now the roof is concrete tiles.
Hmm. And what's the total size of the house?
It's about five hundred square meters in total.
Mm-hmm. And Joe, [beep] can you tell me a bit about where the house is located? This can have an effect on your insurance premiums. For example, the flood risk if you live near a river.
Well, the closest river is thirty minutes drive away.
Oh, that's a long way. Do you live anywhere near a forest?
There is one that backs onto our property, actually. Is that an issue?
It depends. It could be a fire risk. We'll look at our records.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten. Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
And does your house have a garden?
Yes, it does. Most of it is landscaped. My wife and I love getting out there on the weekends.
[chuckles] So do you have an outdoor shed for your tools and things?
Yeah. And we collect and store rainwater, so we have a tank.
Okay. Is there anything else about the house that you'd like to mention? Perhaps any renovations you've made or anything you've added to the property?
We had solar panels installed a couple of years ago.
Mm-hmm. I'll note that down.
So do you also want to insure the contents of your property?
Yes. We have a few valuable items we'd particularly like to insure.
I see.
The first thing is model trains. I've built up a huge collection over the years. You might be surprised to know that my collection is worth more than my car.
Wow. Are there any other items?
We bought a piano for seven thousand dollars last year.
Uh-huh. Sounds like a good one. [laughs] And what about jewelry?
My wife does have some antique jewelry she inherited, especially a necklace that's very valuable.
And why is that?
It's got a beautiful diamond in it that we want to have insured. It belonged to her grandmother.
Okay. One final question. Can I ask who your current insurance company is?
Sure. It's Titan Insurance.
And have you made any claims in the last five years?
Just one. About two years ago, we had a few windows broken when a storm came through our area.
I see. But I assume any damage was repaired.
Yeah. It's all fine.
Okay then. Now let's move on to the next...
That is the end of part one.
